back: softmax(Q·Kᵀ / √d)·V. The score table has n × n entries, so cost grows with n squared.
Cut a series into overlapping patches (for example length 16, stride 8). Each patch is one token.

front: Token count for 512 steps, patch 16, stride 8, end padding 8?
back: 64 tokens. (512 + 8 − 16) // 8 + 1 = 64. Attention is about 64 times cheaper than with 512 tokens.
Each variable is processed as its own univariate series with the same shared weights. No mixing between variables.
Tokens are whole variable series, not time steps. Attention models relations between variables.

front: What did Informer and Autoformer add?
back: Informer: ProbSparse attention, cheaper cost. Autoformer: built-in series decomposition and auto-correlation.
